Commentary.Commentary: The target is a stiff one, Bangladesh have a quality bowling attack but batting does get easier here. Can UAE chase this down?

UAE will be disappointed with how things ended. They were in control for most parts but leaked quite a few runs in the last 5. Karthik, Ali, and Khan were really good but the death bowling can cost them the game.

That innings from Afif has taken Bangladesh to a total that is probably par. It was a struggle for Bangladesh throughout. They just never got going. Their top five were dismissed even before 100 and at that time 140 looked tough but Afif played a total blinder. Hasan played as the perfect foil and the two did brilliantly to take their side over the 150-run mark.

It is time for the first T20I between Bangladesh and UAE! This series will be more or less seen as opportunity to prepare for the upcoming T20I World Cup in Australia. Also, it is between two sides which have struggled in recent times in the shortest version of the game. Bangladesh have not had the best of records in this format whereas UAE have been underperforming in all formats for the last one year or so. Both the teams will want to head to Australia with some kind of form and momentum behind their back. The visitors are favourites heading into this fixture but UAE do have the quality to upset the odds. Stay tuned for the toss in a bit.
